newsitem.title: SPAIN: Santander shares up sharply on restructuring news.
newsitem.headline: Santander shares up sharply on restructuring news.

text.p: Shares in Spain's Banco Santander stayed sharply higher on Monday after the bank said it was to unify treasury, asset management and corporate businesses, dealers said.
This confirmed rumours which had sent the shares up initially, they added.
"We'd heard talk that they were going to merge Santander Investment with Santander itself." said a trader who requested anonymity.
"It makes sense because the costs are enormous and to get all the different investment units under the same roof and share systems is good," he added.
At 1155 GMT, Santander was up 670 pesetas, or 5.52 percent, to 12,800 pesetas, while the Ibex-35 index of leading stocks was up 1.8 percent to 6,548.99.
However the dealer added that he thought the shares were rocketing simply because there were no sellers were very thin on the ground.
"I think the share price is overreacting," he said.
